name: Michał Gromadzki
method: Read-only public Kaggle About and Competitions pages, then his publicly linked GitHub profile, in the app's built-in browser on 30 Oct 2026. Page text, the per-row medal labels and a screenshot of the competition list were read. No older draft existed for this player, so nothing here is carried over from a previous file. The Kaggle and GitHub avatar images were read from the live pages and compared by file fingerprint.

His GitHub avatar (avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/72541880) is GitHub's auto-generated peach blocky pattern, a 420 by 420 image with SHA-256 aafe5be2561ec2d99ffb26049611817b1824b1b5416c30f86d1259d6583908fc. Neither is a photo or a chosen picture, so no file was saved. The card's current art (the 29 Oct fictional copper fox mascot) was generated from that GitHub pattern and is a newspaper stand-in, not his picture; it should not be presented as his portrait. His GitHub page also lists a LinkedIn address, which was not opened because it needs a sign-in.

teamNotes: The Nemotron silver medal belongs to a three-account entry (piotrwilczyski, majkel1337, kaziakazanowska). Credit it as a team medal only, never as his own individual honour.
Kaggle's competition list shows no team name on any of his four completed entries, so teamName is null throughout. Do not invent one.
The Pokémon, Kaggriculture and BirdCLEF rows each show only the majkel1337 account.

The record's ARC-2 and ARC-3 memberships (team Majkel1337) come from the public ARC roster observed on 29 Oct 2026 and were not re-read here. Kaggle's own page confirms only that the account is entered in both active ARC Prize 2026 competitions. Any ARC standing is provisional until the competition closes.
unverified: The older claim that his own LexiGen write-up credits the full name Michał Gromadzki was not re-checked. The name link here rests on the GitHub profile his Kaggle page links to.
His Samsung R&D Institute Poland role is his own GitHub self-description and has not been checked against any other source.

The December 2021 join month comes from a hover tooltip found by pattern match, corroborated only by the page's relative label 'Joined 4 years ago'; the page's other date tooltip was not matched to anything on the page and was not used.
Exact completion dates were not displayed; only relative labels (for example 16 days ago) are shown.
The profile's activity line (6 solo, 1 in a team) was recorded as displayed and is not reconciled with the four completed and two active entries.
No individual picture of him was found. LinkedIn (in/mgromadzki, linked from GitHub) was not opened because it needs a sign-in, so the absence is limited to the Kaggle and GitHub avatars.
The gold and silver medals were read from the per-row medal labels on the live page; Kaggle's medal rows were not cross-checked against the individual competition leaderboards.
